path.description: Path to the file (relative to workspace or absolute)

start_line.description: First line to read (1-based, default: 1). Preferred over "offset".

offset.description: Alias for start_line (1-based, default: 1). Ignored when "start_line" is also set.

pages.description: PDF only: page range to extract, e.g. "1-5" or "10". Ignored for non-PDF files.

around_line.description: Differential read: center the window on this 1-based line (overrides start_line/offset when set).

context_radius.description: Half-window size when around_line is set (default 40, max 250). Total lines ≈ 2*radius+1.

symbol.description: Differential read: look up this symbol in the workspace symbol index and center the read window on its definition line.

around_last_edit.description: Differential read: center on the last successful edit window for this path (from session anchors).

since_tool_use_id.description: Differential read: reuse the citation window from a prior tool_use_id (session anchors).
